findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 257 requests to 70 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

52 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), bidr.io (Beeswax, advertising), bidswitch.net (Iponweb (BidSwitch), advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising).
123 cookies were set by third-party domains (158 cookies in total).
